Practice questions

Question 1
Which Google Cloud service runs a managed Apache Beam pipeline?
A. Dataflow
B. Cloud Storage
Answer: A
Explanation: Dataflow is the managed runner for Apache Beam.

Question 2
Wich option is cheaper for fault-tolerant batch work?
A. On-demand VMs
B. Spot VMs
C. Sole-tenant nodes
Explanation: Spot VMs use spare capacity at a discount. On-demand VMs and sole-tenant nodes cost more.

A. Router
